# Glossy

> > Glossy is a leading trade publication covering the business of fashion and beauty, focusing on retail strategy, technology innovation, and industry transformation.

Glossy delivers in-depth reporting on how major beauty and fashion brands like MAC Cosmetics, Sephora, Ulta, L'Oréal USA, and Eileen Fisher are adapting to digital commerce, leveraging technology, and responding to consumer demands for diversity and inclusivity. The publication features insights from industry leaders including Jessica Schiffer, Jill Manoff, and Maghan McDowell.

## Key Topics

- Retail Strategy
- Beauty Industry

- [Amazon taps into the indie beauty craze with new online store](https://www.glossy.co/beauty/amazon-taps-into-the-indie-beauty-craze-with-new-online-store): Amazon launches dedicated online store for indie beauty brands
- [High-tech is the new standard for in-store beauty experiences](https://www.glossy.co/beauty/high-tech-is-the-new-standard-for-in-store-beauty-experiences): Technology transforms in-store beauty retail experiences
- [From lipstick swatches to live demos: How store associates are boosting online beauty sales](https://www.glossy.co/beauty/from-lipstick-swatches-to-live-demos-how-store-associates-are-boosting-online-beauty-sales): Store associates drive online beauty sales through demos and swatches
- [Estee Lauder Cos. focuses on digital presence for growth in China](https://www.glossy.co/beauty/estee-lauder-focuses-on-digital-presence-for-growth-in-china): Estee Lauder expands China market through digital strategy
